title: Multiplicities on the Fermat quartic
plain: The surface x⁴+y⁴+z⁴ = 1 has the symmetries of a cube. Show its Laplace eigenvalues never repeat more than symmetry forces, except perhaps finitely often.
math: Let $S=\{x^4+y^4+z^4=1\}$ with the induced metric. Prove that all but finitely many Laplace eigenvalues of $S$ have multiplicity at most $3$.
